name: Entrance
details: a small stream of water crosses the room from holes in the walls.

interactables.name: black-violet butterflies
interactables.interaction: eat the butterflies: heal d6 hp

connections.description: two wooden doors ajar. faint violin music can be heard from behind both.
flight of stairs leading back outside

name: Dining Room
description: warm and bright. rotten smell. faint, sad violin music from the north.

connections.description: creaking door to the guard room. the guards audibly complain and move about

details: large wooden table with 20 chairs. set with mugs, plates and spoons but no food or drink

interactables.name: a bearded man
interactables.description: sits at the far end of the table. skin ashen grey, eyes dark, dressed in a dusty old cloak. it is impossible to communicate or contact him. you can poke, hit, or attack him without response.
interactables.interaction: if everyone is seated at the table: the man comes to his senses and erupts with rumbling laughter. he tells stories of old for a few minutes but slowly and irrevocably regresses into his own world again

dangers: the guards in room 4 hear any noise made here.
